    c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, district.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993-%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN account ON client.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE disp.disp_id = (SELECT disp_id FROM card WHERE card.card_id = (SELECT card_id FROM card WHERE card.issued = (SELECT MAX(issued) FROM card)))) 
WHERE client.gender = 'F' 
AND client.birth_date < '1950-12-31' 
AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END. * 100.0) / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_of_male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  ((t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM 
  trans t1
JOIN 
  trans t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
JOIN 
  loan l ON t1.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
  l.date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM loan WHERE date >= '1993-07-05')
  AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27';

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_running
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS state,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12 * 100) AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    l.status = 'D';

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
  AND loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
  AND loan.amount >= 250000 
  AND loan.status = 'approved';

SELECT d.A2
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = '1' 
  AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A15 = (
    SELECT DISTINCT d2.A15
    FROM district d2
    ORDER BY d2.A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%'
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date LIKE '1998%')

SELECT DISTINCT a.type
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.type != 'OWNER'
  AND d.A11 > 8000
  AND d.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT AVG(d.A15) 
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A15 > 4000 
  AND a.date >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT t.date, t.amount, t.operation, t.bank, t.account 
FROM trans t
JOIN client c ON t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3356))
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER' AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3356));

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END. * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.disp_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT 
  ((SUM(l1.amount) - SUM(l2.amount)) * 100.0 / SUM(l2.amount)) AS growth_rate
FROM 
  loan l1
  JOIN account a1 ON l1.account_id = a1.account_id
  JOIN client c1 ON a1.district_id = c1.district_id
  JOIN loan l2 ON a1.account_id = l2.account_id
  JOIN client c2 ON a1.district_id = c2.district_id
WHERE 
  c1.gender = 'M'
  AND l1.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND l2.date LIKE '1996%'
  AND l1.date > l2.date;

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol 
FROM account a 
JOIN order o ON a.account_id = o.account_id 
WHERE o.account_to = 3539;

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' THEN 1 END)) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN account a ON c.client_id = (SELECT disp.client_id FROM disp WHERE disp.account_id = a.account_id LIMIT 1)
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, c.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C' OR l.status = 'D'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.operation = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  );

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    (julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS age 
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'gold' 
    AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%' 
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM trans t 
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id 
      AND t.date >= a.date 
      AND t.type = 'issue'
  );

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'east Bohemia' 
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';
